resources.string: Locked apps open after your fingerprint or screen lock, and stay unlocked until the screen turns off. The phone app and the home screen always open.
To lock apps, set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) first.
Photos, videos and files here are encrypted on the phone and open only with your fingerprint or screen lock. Turning off the screen lock erases the vault\'s key: save copies first.
Nothing here yet. Add photos, videos or files, or share them to the vault from any app.
The vault has encrypted copies. Remove the %d originals from the phone\'s storage?
Delete \"%s\" from the vault? It can\'t be recovered.
The vault\'s key was erased when the screen lock was turned off, so its files can\'t be opened anymore.
Erase the vault and all its files? This can\'t be undone.
To use the vault, set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) first.
